evidence: A compact model on stated paths of technology. The settlement's needs per resident are the founding design's, moving with the paths; the paths beyond their sourced starting values, the unit values of local work and of imported equipment, the bound on visits and the transport multiples are the study's own. Results are conditional on all of them and show how far the technology carries the outcome.
units: Years of the programme (zero is 2041), residents, kilograms, watts, constant USD2041.
reading_rule: Each account is one ramp of residents, one scenario of demand and one technology case. Funding needed is the deepest cumulative shortfall from year zero; the net present value discounts every year's net at 3% to year zero; the payback year is the first after the opening in which the cumulative account is not negative. Checks give the visitors, the mass imported, the launches from Earth at 100 t and the pads at 76 launches a year, the settlement's mean power and the receipts by line in the horizon's year.
